<h1 id="film-grain的定义与作用"><strong>Film Grain的定义与作用</strong></h1>
<p>Film Grain是一种模拟传统摄影胶片颗粒感的后期处理效果，通过添加随机噪点纹理增强画面的艺术表现力。其核心用途包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>复古风格模拟：重现胶片摄影的颗粒质感，增强怀旧氛围</li>
<li>画面细节强化：掩盖低分辨率纹理的瑕疵，提升视觉丰富度</li>
<li>电影感塑造：配合色调映射、色差等效果构建电影级视觉风格</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="发展历史"><strong>发展历史</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>传统胶片时代</strong>‌：物理银盐颗粒形成的自然噪点</li>
<li>‌<strong>数字时代初期</strong>‌：通过简单噪声算法模拟（如Perlin噪声）</li>
<li>‌<strong>现代游戏引擎</strong>‌：HDRP/URP等管线集成预设化系统，支持物理准确的颗粒分布模型（如Kodak系列预设）</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="原理">原理</h1>
<p>Unity URP中的Film Grain效果通过噪声纹理叠加和亮度响应曲线实现胶片颗粒模拟.</p>
<h2 id="噪声生成机制"><strong>噪声生成机制</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>预设纹理采样</strong>‌：内置Kodak/Agfa等胶片颗粒的预烘焙LUT纹理（64x64分辨率），通过屏幕UV坐标进行双线性采样</li>
<li>‌<strong>动态噪声合成</strong>‌：当选择"Custom"模式时，使用Simplex噪声算法实时生成3D噪声场，通过时间参数实现动态流动效果</li>
<li>‌<strong>色彩空间转换</strong>‌：噪声值在YCoCg色彩空间进行混合，避免RGB通道直接叠加导致的色偏问题</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="亮度响应系统"><strong>亮度响应系统</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c">hlsl
float grainIntensity = intensity * (1 - smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, luminance));
</code></pre>
<p>该公式根据像素亮度动态调节颗粒强度，使暗部保留更多噪点（响应曲线参数控制过渡斜率）</p>
<h2 id="实现示例"><strong>实现示例</strong></h2>
<p>该Shader实现包含噪声纹理平铺、亮度自适应调节和色彩安全混合三个关键技术点</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Filmgrain.shader</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">Shader "PostProcessing/FilmGrain"
{
    Properties {
        _GrainTex ("Noise Texture", 2D) = "white" {}
        _Intensity ("Intensity", Range(0,1)) = 0.5
        _Response ("Response", Range(0,1)) = 0.8
    }
    SubShader {
        Pass {
            HLSLPROGRAM
            #include "Packages/com.unity.render-pipelines.universal/ShaderLibrary/Core.hlsl"

            TEXTURE2D(_GrainTex);
            SAMPLER(sampler_GrainTex);
            float _Intensity;
            float _Response;

            float4 Frag(Varyings input) : SV_Target {
                float2 uv = input.uv * float2(80,45); // 平铺噪声
                float3 grain = SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(_GrainTex,sampler_GrainTex,uv).rgb;

                float luminance = Luminance(SceneColor.rgb);
                float adaptive = lerp(1.0, 1.0-luminance, _Response);

                return SceneColor * (1.0 + grain * _Intensity * adaptive);
            }
            ENDHLSL
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="管线集成流程"><strong>管线集成流程</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>渲染阶段</strong>‌：在URP的PostProcessingStack中插入FilmGrainPass，执行顺序在Tonemapping之后、FXAA之前</li>
<li>‌<strong>性能优化</strong>‌：采用1/4分辨率渲染噪声纹理，通过硬件线性滤波降低带宽消耗</li>
<li>‌<strong>移动端适配</strong>‌：使用ARM NEON指令集加速噪声计算，在GPU Tile-Based架构下减少内存访问次数</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="urp实现流程"><strong>URP实现流程</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>FilmGrainExample.cs</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;
using UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal;

[VolumeComponentMenu("Post-processing/Film Grain")]
public class CustomFilmGrain : VolumeComponent, IPostProcessComponent {
    public FilmGrainLookupParameter type = new FilmGrainLookupParameter(FilmGrainLookup.Kodak_200);
    public ClampedFloatParameter intensity = new ClampedFloatParameter(0f, 0f, 1f);
    public ClampedFloatParameter response = new ClampedFloatParameter(0.8f, 0f, 1f);

    public bool IsActive() =&gt; intensity.value &gt; 0f;
    public bool IsTileCompatible() =&gt; false;
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>FilmGrainRenderer.cs</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;
using UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal;

public class FilmGrainRenderer : ScriptableRendererFeature {
    class CustomPass : ScriptableRenderPass {
        // 渲染逻辑实现...
    }
    public override void Create() {
        // 初始化代码...
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="参数详解与用例"><strong>参数详解与用例</strong></h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>参数</th>
<th>类型</th>
<th>说明</th>
<th>典型用例</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Type</td>
<td>Enum</td>
<td>预设颗粒类型（Kodak200/400等）</td>
<td>选择Agfa400模拟16mm胶片</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Intensity</td>
<td>0-1</td>
<td>颗粒可见度</td>
<td>0.3-0.5用于复古RPG游戏</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Response</td>
<td>0-1</td>
<td>亮度响应曲线</td>
<td>0.7使亮部颗粒减弱</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Texture</td>
<td>2D</td>
<td>自定义噪点贴图</td>
<td>制作数字故障艺术效果</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h1 id="操作步骤urp-20221"><strong>操作步骤（URP 2022.1+）</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>创建Volume对象：<code>GameObject &gt; Volume</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>添加Film Grain覆盖：<code>Add Override &gt; Film Grain</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置参数示例：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Type = Kodak500T<br>
Intensity = 0.4<br>
Response = 0.65</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="性能优化建议"><strong>性能优化建议</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>移动端使用Quarter分辨率</li>
<li>动态调整Intensity（剧情过场时增强）</li>
<li>禁用非必要时的Volume更新</li>
</ul>
